description:
Aufgaben:
• Master's degree in (astro-) physics, astronomy, planetary science, or a related field

• Strong background in numerical modeling and computational methods

• Experience with SPH / N-body simulations, granular physics, or geophysical modeling is an advantage

• Programming skills (e.g., Python, Julia, C/C++, or similar)

• Interest in planetary science, astronomy and small-body research

• Ability to work collaboratively in an international team

• Fluency in written and spoken English

Anforderungen:
• A fully funded PhD position at the University of Bern (with salary following the guidelines of the University of Bern)

• Participation in a cutting-edge ESA mission with high scientific impact

• Access to state-of-the-art computational resources

• A collaborative and international research environment

• Opportunities for conference participation and scientific networking

Wir bieten:
Collaborative environment and ambitious team

Linee guida dell'Università di Berna - Partecipazione a una missione ESA all'avanguardia con un alto impatto scientifico - Accesso a risorse computazionali all'avanguardia - Un ambiente di ricerca collaborativo e internazionale - Opportunità di partecipazione a conferenze e di networking scientifico Co-Babamo - Ambiente di tipo alacre e team ambizioso
